definitions.cmd: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && node --test scripts/sound-cues.test.mjs && node -e "const s=require('./package.json').scripts; process.exit(s.check.includes('pnpm test:sound-cues') && (s['test:sound-cues']||'').includes('scripts/sound-cues.test.mjs') ? 0 : 1)"
definitions.expect: Proposed, not run. With the package-specified Node and pnpm versions, install dependencies and run the new exact test file. Start with empty preference storage and no user gesture: assert Sound off and no audio start. Activate the plain menu Sound control through a user gesture, reload and assert the preference persists without replaying history. Submit 'How does photosynthesis store energy?' through production UI integration with deterministic external responses; assert exactly one quiet, short tick after the unmarked reply finishes. Supply a reply marked as a hint, then a marked answer: assert no tick. Restore saved history: assert no tick. Repeat with Sound off, then prefers-reduced-motion set: assert no tick. Repeat completion delivery for one reply: assert one tick total. Verify each planted fault is caught: a tick on a marked hint, a tick on restored history, a tick with Sound off, a tick with reduced motion, and two ticks for one reply. The corresponding zero-start or one-start assertion must fail for each fault. There is no chime clause. The final wiring assertion exits zero only when pnpm check includes pnpm test:sound-cues and that script names scripts/sound-cues.test.mjs. Scope and preview evidence are supplied by the separate records.
definitions.failure_case: Any planted forbidden tick or duplicate tick, a missing gesture guard, an unsaved or default-on toggle, or missing pnpm check wiring must fail this regression.
definitions.missing: scripts/sound-cues.test.mjs and the production sound implementation are not present in the inspected listings. Add behavior-named tests for default-off and saved toggle state, gesture gating, single fresh reply completion, marked assistance silence, restored-history silence, Sound-off silence, reduced-motion silence and duplicate completion. Use the repository's node:test runner and production integration, with fakes only at external boundaries. Add test:sound-cues to package.json and pnpm check. The explicit file invocation fails if the file is absent; it does not rely on a name filter.
definitions.statement: The tick regression checks the tick, the toggle and the silence rules, with no chime clause; the tick regression catches a tick on a marked hint, a tick on restored history, a tick with Sound off, a tick with reduced motion, and two ticks for one reply; Tests run in pnpm check; the tick regression command ends with: node -e "const s=require('./package.json').scripts; process.exit(s.check.includes('pnpm test:sound-cues') && (s['test:sound-cues']||'').includes('scripts/sound-cues.test.mjs') ? 0 : 1)"; the scope-guard command checks no new dependency, no audio files, and no server, inference or reveal-logic change: B=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) && git diff --quiet "$B" -- pnpm-lock.yaml src/server src/inference src/learning src/reveal.ts src/ui/reveal-mark.ts && ! git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A "$B" | grep -Eiq '\.(mp3|wav|ogg|m4a|aac|flac|webm)$'; the browser judgment of the toggle and tick happens on the PR's Vercel preview before merge.

definitions.expect: Proposed, not run. Starting from the candidate checkout with the package-specified Node and pnpm versions, install locked dependencies and run the full gate. All constituent checks, including the newly wired test:sound-cues regression, exit successfully. The build may write generated output under dist. This is suite verification, not browser judgment or learner acceptance.
definitions.failure_case: A failing sound regression, type error, failed existing assertion or failed build must fail the full gate.
A loud, long or repeated tick, forbidden sound, lost preference, non-plain menu control, inaccessible toggle, audio console error, or judgment performed only after merge must not pass.
definitions.how_to_judge: Before merge, inspect the PR's Vercel preview on a phone. Begin in a fresh browser with reduced motion off: open the menu and confirm Sound is off and is a plain menu line like type size, not a new chip or pill. Turn Sound on, reload and inspect the saved choice without a history tick. Ask 'How does photosynthesis store energy?' and listen as the tutor reply finishes: is there exactly one soft, quiet, short tick? Ask 'Can I have a hint?' and inspect that the supplied hint has its reveal mark and no sound. Reload and listen for silence from restored history. Turn Sound off and repeat the question; then turn Sound on with prefers-reduced-motion set and repeat: both must be silent. Inspect keyboard focus and accessible naming and check for audio-related console errors. Judge whether the tick and menu control fit the existing interface. The answer can require audio tuning or UI repairs before merge; it cannot add a chime or waive silence rules.

definitions.failure_case: A new runtime dependency declared only in package.json or a server change in src/server.ts must not pass scope review even if the exact scope command exits zero.
definitions.how_to_judge: Inspect the candidate diff against its origin/main merge base, including package.json dependency declarations and top-level src/server.ts as well as the paths in the exact scope guard. Has the change added a runtime dependency, audio asset, React or shadcn, or changed server, inference or reveal logic? A boundary violation requires removing that change or surfacing the conflict; a passing scope command alone is not sufficient evidence.
